Cadre AI is an AI strategy and implementation firm. We help you pinpoint the right AI opportunities, implement them seamlessly, and deliver real business impact, focusing on driving revenue growth and improving EBITDA. More: cadre.ai. Want to talk to an AI strategist?

Cadre AI offers four main services:
*   **AI Strategy**: This includes the 45-day AI Transformation Intensive, which provides a prioritized roadmap and ROI estimates. More: cadre.ai/strategy
*   **AI Leadership & Facilitation**: This service transforms executives and teams through various session formats, from 1-hour virtual kickoffs to 2-day intensives. More: cadre.ai/leadership-facilitation
*   **AI Engineering**: Cadre connects your systems, automates workflows, and builds custom solutions when necessary. More: cadre.ai/ai-engineering
*   **AI Agents**: This covers building everything from simple prompts to full AI agents, including voice agents, with guardrails and human oversight. More: cadre.ai/agents
